tei:div.tei:p: 531)༄༅/ rdzogs pa chen po ka dag khregs chod kyi snyan brgyud zin bris kun mkhyen bla ma'i zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 532) ༄༅/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir rig 'dzin chen po 'jigs med gling pa nas snyan brgyud bar ma chad pa'i ka dag khregs chod kyi skor man ngag gcig brgyud rang blor zin tshod ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa theg chen thun mong gi sems 533)bskyed dang*/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin yin yang ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can thams cad rang gnas kyi ye shes/ rang bzhag gi chos sku/ rang rig zung 'jug 'gyur ba med pa'i dbyings su grol bar bgyi'o snyam pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sems ye shes su bskyed pa dang bcas pas/ gang nyams su 534) blang bya/ theg pa rim pa dgu'i rtse mo a ti yo ga rtsol med 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po yin/ a nu yo ga man kyi lam thams cad mnyam bzhag gi dus na ye shes re gtan la dbab kyang rjes thob tu rnam rtog gis dkrugs pas lam rtsol bcas su song ba yin/ a ti yo gas mnyam rjes thams cad du ye shes gcig pu'i ngang skyong bas rtsol med yin/ rdzogs pa chen po de la rgyud 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi/ de bsdu na sems klong man ngag gi sde gsum/ sems sdes snang ba thams cad sems tsam du gtan la dbab/ sems gsal rig de la kun byed rgyal po zhes ming btags pas/ sems sde spang bya'i mtha' las ma grol/ klong sdes 'khor 'das thams cad stong nyid du gtan la dbab/ stong rkyang de la dbyings kun tu bzang mo zhes stong 'dzin dang ma bral bas klong sde gnyen 535)po'i mtha' las ma grol/

man ngag gi sdes sems dang rig pa shan phyes/ rig pa mngon sum car phog tu ngo sprod pas gnad thog gi me btsa' lta bu yin/ man ngag gi sde de la rgyud bcu bdun/ sngags srung khros ma'i rgyud dang bco brgyad/ de dag gi dgongs nyams dril ba kun mkhyen chen po'i mdzod bdun/ ya bzhi/ de dag gi dgongs nyams dril ba rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying thig las/ gzhi rdzogs pa chen po/ lam rdzogs pa chen po/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa chen po dang gsum/ dang po gzhi rdzogs pa chen po ni/ sems can rnams kyi sems kyi babs/ gshis kyi yin lugs/ 'dug tshul/ chos nyid rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin/ de rtogs te sangs rgyas ma byung*/ ma rtogs te sems can ma byung ba'i gzhon nu bum pa'i sku/ lhun grub rin po che'i sbubs 'od lnga nang gsal gyi tshul du 536) yod pa/ dpe rma bya'i sgong chu lta bu/ 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi/ dngul chu dug 'don ma byas pa lta bu/ de nyid rtogs na sangs rgyas pas sbyor ba don gyi kun gzhi/ ma rtogs na 'khrul gzhi byed pas bag chags sna tshogs pa'i kun gzhi/ de nas shes rab srog tu gyur pa'i rlung g.yos pas/ gzhon nu bum sku'i rgya ral te/ steng na dag pa ye shes kyi sgo/ 'og na ma dag 'khor ba'i sgo/ 'od ltar shar ba dang*/ sku ltar shar ba gnyis phyi yul ltar du shar te/ 'od dang 'od khyim za 'og gi ber khyim kha phyes pa lta bu la zhi ba dang khro bo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sku dang ye shes ltar shar ba dang*/ thugs rje ltar shar ba gnyis yul can ltar du shar te/ phyi yul la gzung 'dzin rgyang chad du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog ltar mi 'dzin par ye shes yin pas rig pa'i ye shes ltar shar ba dang*/ dmigs 537)pa med pa'i snying rje chen po'i tshul du shar ba gnyis yul yul can gnyis su med pas gnyis med ltar shar ba dang*/ mtha' thams cad las grol bas mtha' grol ltar shar ba gnyis yul can gyis yul la bya ba byed pa'i tshul du 'char ba ste 'char tshul drug dang*/

sgo gnyis ste lhun grub sgo brgyad kyi snang ba ces bya/ de'i tshe kun tu bzang pos ka dag gi ngo tshul bzhin shes pas ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs/ lhun grub kyi snang ba rang snang yin par shes pas bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs/ gzhi las 'phags/ rang ngor snang*/ bye brag phyed/ phyed thog grol/ rang sar gnas/ ngang las mi g.yo ba ste khyad chos drug gi sangs rgyas pa yin/ sems can rnams kyis ka dag gi rang ngo ma shes pas rgyu bdag nyid gcig pa'i ma rig pa byung*/ lhun grub kyi snang ba rang snang yin 538)par ma shes pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa byung*/ de je rags su song na/ nga las pha ki byung ngam/ pha ki las nga byung nga dpyod pa'i tshe/ dpyod byed du shar/ 'dzin byed du ma shar ba'i kun gzhi dang kun gzhi'i rnam shes dus de nas kun tu btags pa'i ma rig pa ldang*/ yul sems la snang ba'i bag chags bzhag pas skad cig gnyis par yul snang shes pa byung*/ sems kyis yul la dpyod pa'i bag chags bzhag pas skad cig gnyis par yul 'dzin gyi shes pa byung*/ 'od ltar shar ba la 'dzin pa zhugs pas snod kyi 'jig rten gyi smin po byung*/ sku ltar shar ba la 'dzin pa zhugs pas rang gzhan gyi lus kyi smin po byung*/ rig tsam 'gyu tsam gyi ye shes la 'dzin pa zhugs pas sems kyi smin po shar bas rdzogs pa chen po'i lugs la snang ba sems kyang ma yin/ sems las tha 539) dad kyang ma yin/ sems snang bag chags tsam yin par sems tsam rnam rdzun pa dang ming 'dra yang don mi 'dra ste/ rdzogs pa chen po'i snang ba thams cad las snang dang rtsal gzugs gnyis ka yin/ da lta rang re rnams kyis gong ltar 'dzin pas dag pa myang 'das kyi sgo nub/ ma dag 'khor ba'i sgo yi 'gro drug gzhan rnams nub nas mi yi 'khrul snang la spyod pa yin/ da lta'i kun gzhi'i rnam shes 'di rlung gis spur nas nang bdag 'dzin dang sprad dus nyon yid/

phyi yul la g.yo dus yid shes/ dbang po sgo lnga dang 'phrad dus sgo lnga'i rnam shes su gyur pa yin/ de lta bu lan gcig ma yin par da lta yang grangs med por mang po sangs rgyas/ grangs med pa mang por 'khrul bzhin yod/ des 'khrul yun ring thung gi rdzogs pa chen po la rang bzhin gyi dbang po rno brtul bshad 540)pa yin/ 'o na rdzogs pa chen po'i lugs la 'khor ba la thog ma yod dam zhe na/ gzhi la ma rig pa rang chas gser dang g.ya' bzhin 'bral rung du thog med nas yod pas thog ma bzhag tu med/ gang zag sgos btsan lam mthar phyin nas 'khor ba dong nas sprugs te nam grol ba'i tshe tha ma ni yod/ de ni gzhi rdzogs pa chen po yin/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa chen po ni/ sems kyi gshis ngo bo ye dag gi sangs rgyas/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi sangs rgyas/ gzhi lhun grub kyi sangs rgyas ye nas yin pa de/ lam rgyud la bsten pas glo bur gyi sgrib pa 'bral rung du yod pa cha dang bcas pa dag nas yin lugs ji lta ba mngon du gyur pa ni 'bras bu rdzogs pa chen po yin/ lam rdzogs pa chen po la/ smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi gdams pa gnyis/ dang po/ rgyud sde gong ma'i dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che 541) la nang gses spros bcas/ spros med/ shin tu spros med/ rab tu spros med bzhi'i phye ba'i dbang gis rgyud smin nas/ dbang srog rgyud la 'dzin pa dam tshig rnam par dag pa la rag las pas so byang sngags kyi sdom pa dang dam tshig mtha' dag man ngag gi sgo nas bsdu na/ mi dge bcu po cha dang bcas pa spong ba la 'du/ grol byed kyi gdams pa la/ le lo can 'bad med du grol ba ka dag khregs chod dang*/ brtson 'grus can 'bad bcas su grol ba lhun grub thod rgal gnyis las/ dang po la/ sngon 'gro sems kyi khang bu gtib pa/ dngos gzhi rig pa rang ngo sprod pa/ rjes nyams kyis bskyang tshul bstan pa dang gsum yod/

der zhag gcig 'di phan chad nas thun dang thun mtshams phye nas bsgom dgos pas thun re re bzhin lus gnad chos bdun/ ngag 542)gnad rlung ro bsal ba/ sems gnad kun slong bcos pa/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ thun dngos la dpyad 'jog spel mar bsgom dgos/ gong gi sa bcad dang po gnyis go bde bar bsam na/ sems rtsad bcad pa/ mtshang btsal ba/ thun mong pa byung gnas 'gro gsum brtag pa/ thun mong ma yin pa yul can sems kyi gshis lugs la brtags nas gnas lus 'od gsal chen por gtan la dbab pa dang bzhi las/ dang po la 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems yin/ de ci'i phyir snyam na/ chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis kun nas bslang*/ las mi dge ba bcu spyad/ chen pos dmyal ba/ 'bring gis yi dwags/ chung ngus dud 'gro ste ngan song gsum du skye ba'i rgyu sgrub kyang sems gtso bo lus ngag gnyis grogs/ yang 543)dag pa'i dad pas kun nas slong*/ bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gsum sgrub/ mngon mtho lha dang mi yi go 'phang bsgrub kyang sems gtso bo/ lus ngag gnyis grogs/ nges 'byung gi bsam pas kun nas slong*/ lam lhag pa'i bslab pa rin po che gsum la bslab/ thar pa nyan rang gi go 'phang sgrub kyang sems gtso bo/ lus ngag gnyis grogs/ byang chub sems kyi kun nas slong*/ lam pha rol du phyin pa drug la bslab/ rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bsgrub kyang sems gtso bo/ lus ngag gnyis grogs/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bskyed rim kyi thun mong gi dngos grub/ rdzogs rim gyis mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub kyang sems gtso bo/ lus ngag gnyis grogs/ dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med lhag pa'i chos sku rin po che'i lta bas rtsis zin pa'i bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug bsgom/ 544)mchog thun dngos grub cig char bsgrub kyang sems gtso bo/ lus ngag gnyis grogs/ mdor na 'khor 'das kyi bya ba gang bsgrub kyang sems gtso che bas rtsad gcod pa la zhag gsum sgom mo/

de rigs pas sgrub pa yin/ lung gi sgrub pa ni/ yid gtso yid ni rab tu mgyogs pa ste// chos rnams kun gyi sna la de 'gro'o/ zhes dang*/ dge ba dang ni sdig pa'i chos// las rnams sems kyis byed pa yin/ zhes rgyal ba'i bka' las gsungs pa dang*/ khyed kyi thugs dul mdzod cig bcom ldan gyis// sems ni chos kyi rtsa ba lags par gsungs/ ces/ bstan bcos las byung ba sogs/ mdor na bka' dang dgongs 'grel thams cad nas sems gtso che bar gsungs pa las/ gtso mi che zhes pa'i lung btsal yang mi rnyed pas so/ de lung gis sgrub pa yin/ gnyis pa mtshang btsal ba/ lus zhes 545)pa ni 'bral zhing shul du lus pas lus ces bya la/ mi rnams 'chi ba'i tshe lus shul du bskyur te lus pas na lus yin/ 'o na lha sogs kyi lus ni 'chi ba'i tshe 'pho ltung gi sdug bsngal gyis nyin tshan du mar gong du bzhag pa ltar shul du lus pa med do snyam na/ lus dang sems gnyis 'bral ba'i snang ba yod pas na/ 'bral zhing zhes brjod pa yin/ ngag ni yid brjod 'dod kyi rtog pas rlung g.yos/ rtsa yi ge 'khor lo'i rang sgra grags pa yin/ sems ni/ yul la sems pas na sems/ yul yid la byed pas yid/ yul gyi rnam pa shes pas rnam shes rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin/ lus ngag yid gsum po de la mtshang ngam skyon ci zhig yod na/ sems can rnams kyis res 'ga' gcig tu bzung nas nga zhes brjod/ res 'ga' tha dad du bzung nas 546)nga yis mgo sogs brjod/ de gnyis gang rung las gnyis ka yin min mi shes pas/ gcig yin no snyam na/ lus mig gi mthong rung ba dang*/ ngag rna bas thos rung ba bzhin sems mthong thos rung dgos/ sems mthong thos mi rung ba bzhin du lus ngag mthong thos mi rung ba'i skyon yod pas gcig ma yin/ tha dad na rtag pa/ gcig pu/ rang dbang gis tha dad dang*/ mi rtag du ma gzhan dbang gi tha dad gnyis las yod mi shes pas/

lus rtag pa ma yin te/ rags pa 'gyur ba'i mi rtag pa ni/ byis pa nas/ rgan po'i bar du 'gyur ba dang*/ phra ba chos nyid kyi mi rtag pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin/ skad cig re re bzhin 'gyur bas mi rtag pa yin/ gcig pu ma yin te/ rus dum sum brgya drug cu/ skra nyi khri chig stong drug brgya sogs yod pas 547) du ma yin/ rang dbang can ma yin te/ dge ba sgrub dus dge ba'i lus/ mi dge ba sgrub dus mi dge ba'i lus su 'gyur bas lus dge mi dge'i gzhan dbang can yin/ ngag rtag pa ma yin te/ rags pa 'gyur ba'i mi rtag pa/ brjod pa sna tshogs gcig rjes su gcig 'byung ba dang*/ phra ba chos nyid kyi mi rtag pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin dus mtha'i skad cig ma re re bzhin du 'gyur bas mi rtag pa'o/ gcig pu ma yin te/ ka kha sum cu brjod na mi 'dra ba sum cur 'gyur ba yin pas du ma yin/ rang dbang can ma yin te/ yid kyi brjod 'dod la ltos pas ngag yid kyi gzhan dbang can yin no/ sems rtag pa ma yin te/ rags pa 'gyur ba'i mi rtag pa/ rnam rtog mi 'dra ba'i grangs bzhin 'gyur 548)ba dang*/ phra ba chos nyid kyi mi rtag pa/ dper na chu bo chen po'i drung du song te lham chus khyer shor ba las/ nyin phyi mar song te kha sang chu 'dis lham khyer shor brjod na 'dra ba gzhan byung gi 'khrul rgyus bslad de gcig tu 'dzin pa las/ kha sang gi chu yi rdul phran tsam yang de ring med/ de bzhin du sems rnam par rtog pa yang skad cig gis 'gyur nas 'gro bas mi rtag pa yin/ gcig pu ma yin te/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi rnam rtog ci skyes kyi grangs su 'gyur bas du ma yin/ rang dbang can ma yin te/ yul bzang ngan gyi rjes su 'brang bas sems yul gyi gzhan dbang can yin/ de yan dpyad 'jog spel mas zhag gsum sgom mo/ mi rtag du ma gzhan dbang can gyi tha dad de grub bam snyam na ma grub ste/

lus bems po/ 549)sems shes pa yin pas/ rang gi lus der lus zhes btags kyang*/ dpyad na ma grub te/ blo shes rab kyi ral gris rim par phye bas/ mgo dang rkang lag so sor sdes phye ba na/ ril po gcig tu 'dzin pa zhig ste re re bzhin lus ma yin/ 'o na yan lag so so ba de yod do snyam na/ mgo sogs dum bu bzhi rer phye bas mgo sogs kyang ma grub/ nying lag rnams grub bam snyam na/ de rnams bzhi rer phye bas ma grub/ de dag kyang rim par bshig pas/ mthar rdul phran nyag gcig tu song*/ de la zhig pa'i rdul phran cha med dang*/ gzhal ba'i rdul phran cha med gnyis las/ bshig nas sna tha btul ba'i rdul ltar byas pa dang po yin/ rdul phran re re la'ang blos gzhal na phyogs bzhi steng 'og tu bltas 550)ba'i cha drug re yod nges la/ cha drug de so sor drug tu dbye/ de re re la'ang cha drug drug tu dbye/ cha med chas dbye bas/ mthar yod na cha drug yod/ med na thams cad med pas/ de ltar blos gtan la phabs ste rang bzhin du grub pa rdul tsam med par nges pas lus stong pa'o/ zhes gsungs/ stong nyid cir yang ma yin pa la rten 'byung 'gag med du 'char bas stong pa nyid lus ltar snang*/ de gnyis dbyer med pas/ lus las kyang stong nyid gzhan ma yin/ stong pa nyid las kyang lus gzhan ma yin/ zhes stong nyid bzhi sbyor gyi nges pa drang*/ ngag ni theg dman skabs sgra rdul yin par gsungs pas/ rdul de la cha drug drug tu brtags pas rang bzhin med pa'i stong nyid bzhi sbyor gyi nges shes bskyed/ 551)sems rnam par rtog pa ni 'das pa 'gags zin pas med/ ma 'ongs pa ma skyes pas med/ da lta skad cig ma gcig las med pas kyang ma grub bo/ de yan chad la zhag gsum dpyad 'jog spel mar sgom mo/ sa bcad gsum pa thun mong ba 'byung gnas 'gro gsum brtag pa la/ thun mong ba zhes pa mdo lam gyi phung po rnam dpyad kyi stong nyid dang*/

'dir 'byung gnas 'gro gsum brtag pa rnams thun mong ba yin pas/ kun mkhyen chen pos sems lam du byed pa'i theg pa dang*/ ye shes lam du byed pa'i theg pa zhes gsungs pa'i snga ma theg chen mdo sngags gnyis ka'i lta ba thun mong ba yin pas thun mong zhes brjod/ lta ba la/ lta yul dang*/ lta ba gnyis/ snga ma ni byung gnas 'gro 552)gsum dpyod pa'i yul gdod nas blos ma gzhag pa'i yul gyi stong nyid spros bral de yin/ phyi ma ni 'byung gnas 'gro gsum yod med dpyad pas rang gzhin med pa'i stong nyid la nges shes kyi blo gzhan gyis 'phrog tu med pa zhig skye ba yin/ sgra thal 'gyur rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ chos can blta ba'i lta ba/ chos nyid blta ba'i lta ba/ rang rig lta ba'i lta ba/ gsum du gsungs pa'i dang po chos can blta ba'i lta ba ni/ las rgyu 'bras sogs tha snyad kyi rnam bzhag thams cad dpyad pas de dag gi mtshan nyid ji lta bar nges pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ phung po rnam dpyad kyis yul gyi stong nyid la nges pa dang*/ gsum pa ni/ yul can gyi ye shes mngon du rtogs pa yin/ rdzogs pa chen po'i ngo bo shes pa'i shes pa dang*/ rang bzhin shes pa'i shes 553)pa gnyis las phyi ma ni/ ye shes lam du byed pa yin/ snga ma sems lam du byed po'i byung gnas 'gro gsum brtag pa la/ 'byung sa'i yul brtag pa dang*/ byung mkhan gyi blo brtag pa gnyis/ dang po la'ang*/ sems rnam rtog phyi'i yul las byung snyam na/ mig gi yul du gyur pa'i gzugs/ sngo ser dkar dmar ste rtsa ba'i kha dog bzhi/ snang mun sprin dang du ba rdul dang khug sna/ nyi ma grib ma ste yan lag gi kha dog brgyad/ ring thung mchog dman lham zlum phyal dang phyal min ste dbyibs gzugs brgyad/ mdor na mig gis snang du rung ba ri rwa ba brag khang khyim/ skyes pa bud med/ gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya sogs/ gzugs su gtogs pa thams cad rags pa dum bur bsh-ig

dum bu phye mar phye ma rdul phran/ nyi zer gyi rdul 'bring po gcig la cha bzhi bcur 554)'phangs pa'i cha gcig gi bar zhig pa'i rdul phran cha med dang*/ de gcig la'ang*/ shar la blta ba'i cha gcig lho ru blta ba'i cha gcig nub tu blta ba'i cha gcig byang du blta ba'i cha gcig steng du blta ba'i cha gcig 'og tu blta ba'i cha gcig ste cha drug yod pa blo gros so sor bsal bas/ nyi shu pa las/ drug gi gcig char sbyar ba yis// phra rab rdul cha drug tu 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin dpyad/ yang so sor bsal ba'i re re la'ang phyogs bzhi steng 'og gnyis dang drug re dbye/ de re re la'ang drug drug tu dbye bas/ cung zad tsam zhig yod pa ni cha drug drug tu dbyer rung bas/ rdul cha tsam yang med par gtan la dbab pa ni/ gzhal ba'i rdul phran cha med kyi cha phye 555)bas rang bzhin med pa'i stong nyid du gtan la dbab pa ni/ mdo las gzugs stong pa'o/ zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du rna ba'i yul du gyur pa'i zin pa dang ma zin pa/ lung du ston mi ston/ re re la'ang snyan mi snyan te/ sgra ji snyed yod pa'i sgra rdul de gang ltar rags pa rdul phran/ rdul phran cha med/ cha med rang bzhin med par gtan la phab/ sna yi yul du gyur pa'i dri zhim mi zhim cha mnyam mi mnyam thams cad kyang*/ rags pa rdul phran sogs/ rang bzhin med par gtan la phab/ lce yi yul gyi ro mngar skyur lan tshwa kha tsha bska ba rnams rags pa rdul phran/ rdul phran cha med/ cha med de zhig pa'i cha med dang*/ gzhal ba'i cha med/ so sor dbye bas rang bzhin med gtan la phab/ lus kyi yul gyi reg bya sra gsher/ 556)drod g.yo ste rgyu 'byung ba'i reg bya/ 'jam rtsub lci yang bkres skom grang ba'i 'bras bu'i reg bya rnams rags pa rdul phran nas/ rang bzhin med par gtan la phab yid kyi yul chos khams/ dbang po sgo lngas yul mi mthong ba'i dus kyang*/

yul gyi bag chags sems la bsgos pas/ sems thog tu rnam rtog skye sa'i yul zhig yod pa 'di'ang*/ phyi rol gyi yul gzugs lta bu de ma grub na/ yid chos khams kyi yul gzugs brnyan lta bu de yang mi 'grub/ de ltar yul drug ma grub na ma med na bu skye mi shes pa bzhin sems ma grub/ 'o na nang dbang po las sems 'byung ngam snyam na/ mig gi dbang po zar ma'i me tog lta bu/ rna ba'i dbang po gro ga'i 'dzer bu gcus pa lta bu/ sna yi dbang po zangs ky-i mo khab gshibs pa lta bu/ 557)lce yi dbang po zla ba bkas pa lta bu/ lus kyi dbang po bya rog na 'jam gyi lpags pa lta bu ste/ dbang po gzugs can pa lnga po yang*/ rags pa rdul phran sogs nas/ rang bzhin med par gtan la dbab/ drug po 'das ma thag pa yi// rnam shes gang yin de yid do/ zhes skad cig snga rim du skye ba'i yid dbang kyang 'das ma 'ongs da ltar ste dus gsum du brtags pas ma grub/ de ltar nang dbang po drug med na pha med na bu med pa bzhin/ de las byung ba'i sems ma grub/ 'o na yul dbang gnyis kyi bar na 'byung ba zhig yod dam snyam na de gnyis bar na/ nyin bar gyi snang ba'i rdul dang*/ mtshan gyi mun pa'i rdul las gzhan gang yang med/ rdul de gnyis po dpyad na rdul phran rang bzhin med pas ma grub/ des na skye ba'i yul/ 'byung 558)ba'i yul/ 'ong ba'i yul rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin pas/ byung pa'i yul de ga rang bzhin med pas yul stong pa'o/ zhes gsungs/ stong nyid cir yang ma yin pa las rten 'byung gi snang ba 'gag med du 'char bas/ stong pa nyid yul ltar snang*/ snang dus nyid nas stong pas rtag lta sel/ stong bzhin du snang bas chad lta sel/ snang bzhin du stong*/ stong bzhin du snang*/ snang bas stong pa ma spang sa/ stong pas snang ba ma spangs/ snang ba stong thog tu spyan ma drangs/ stong pa snang thog tu spyan ma drangs/

snang stong srad bu dkar nag sgril ba lta bu ma yin par bzod nas snang stong dbye bsal med pa yin pas/ yul las kyang stong nyid gzhan ma yin/ stong nyid las kyang yul gzhan ma yin 559)zhes/ stong nyid gzhi sbyor gyi nges shes drangs te dpyad/ sems thang chad de dpyad du mi gtub pa na/ sngar 'das kyi rjes mi gcod/ ma 'ongs pa'i mdun mi bsu/ da lta'i rtog pa phro mi mthud par rang babs su ci gnas par bzhag yang rnam rtog gcig ldang ba na/ sngar ltar dpyad 'jog spel ma byas pas sems la kha lo legs par lobs nas/ btang dus chu btang ba lta bu/ bzhag dus spang la be phur 'dzug pa bzhin btang bzhag las su rung nas/ 'dod sems rtse gcig pa 'grub/ de'i tshe gzugs khams pa'i sems 'grub pa dang*/ sems de'i gzhon par gyur pa'i rlung yang 'grub ste/ gnas ngan len spangs ba'i shin sbyang gi bde ba 'byung ba'i bar dpyad 'jog spel ma 'dis zhi gnas sgrub 560)dgos pas/ gong gi dmigs rnam de la zhag gsum bar du bsgom mo/ de ltar byung sa'i yul med par gtan la dbab nas/ da ni byung mkhan gyi blo med par gtan la dbab pa ni/ gsang ba snying po'i rgyud las/ gzhi rtsa med pa'i sems nyid ni// pho mo ma yin ma ning min// mtshan med ma yin rigs brgyud min/ kha dog ma yin dbyibs ma yin// gnas su ma yin gang yang min/ zhes dang*/ rgyud gzhan las/ sems pho mo ma ning min/ mtshan med ma yin/ rigs brgyud min/ zhes gsungs pas/ sems pho ltar du ma grub/ mo ltar du ma grub/ ma ning ltar du ma grub/ mtshan med ltar du ma grub/ rigs brgyud ltar du ma grub/ sngo ser dkar dmar sogs rtsa ba'i kha dog dang yan lag gi kha dog 561)ltar du ma grub/ zlum po/ gru bzhi/ zla gam/ gru gsum/ ring thung sogs/ dbyibs kyi gzugs su ma grub/ dmyal ba tsha grang*/ yi dwags bkres skom/ dud 'gro blun rmongs/ mi skye rga na 'chi/

lha min 'thab rtsod/ lha 'chi 'pho ltung ba sogs 'gro ba rigs drug gi gzugs su ma grub/ gzugs su grub na/ mig gis mthong dgos pa la/ mig gis mthong ba'i sems la gzugs med pas sems gzugs kyis stong*/ sgra snyan mi snyan zin ma zin lung du ston mi ston sogs sems la sgra ma grub/ sgra yod na rna bas thos dgos pa la/ rna bas thos pa'i sgra med pas sems sgra yis stong*/ dri zhim mi zhim bar ma sogs sems la dri ma grub/ dri yod na snas tshor dgos pa la/ snas bsnom pa'i dri med pas sems dri yis stong*/ 562)ro kha mngar skyur sogs sems la ro ma grub/ ro yod na lces myong dgos pa la/ lce yis myong ba'i ro med pas sems ro yis stong*/ reg bya 'jam rtsub lci yang sogs sems la reg bya ma grub/ reg bya yod na lus kyi reg dgos pa la lus kyi reg bya med pas sems reg byas stong*/ de rnams med kyang yid kyi yul chos khams yod do snyam na/ phyi rol gyi gzugs ma grub na gzugs snyan ma grub pas chos khams mi grub/ 'o na rnam rtog breng breng po lam gyis shar ba 'di 'dug gam snyam na/ da ltar yan gyi 'das pa'i rnam rtog thams cad 'gags zin pas/ mi shi tshar ba dang 'dra bas med/ da ltar phyin chad kyi rnam rtog thams cad ma skyes pa ste/ mi sa thog tu skyes med pa ni med pa yin pa dang 'dra bas med/ da lta'i skad cig ma gcig la'ang skad cig snga ma la 563)blta ba'i cha gcig phyi ma la blta ba'i cha gcig da lta rang la ltos pa'i cha gcig ste/ dpyad na cha gsum du dbyer yod la/ gsum gsum du dbye pa'i nang gses cha re re la'ang gsum gsum/ de 'dra bas brtag brtags pas cung zad zhig mchis kyang cha gsum gsum med pa mi srid pas/ dpyad dpyad pas rang bzhin med par grub pa ni sems stong pa'o/ zhes so/ stong nyid cir yang ma yin pa las rten 'byung gi snang ba 'gag med du 'char ba ni stong pa nyid sems so/

stong rten 'byung dbye bsal med pas sems las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin/ stong nyid las kyang sems gzhan ma yin par stong nyid bzhi sbyor gyi nges shes drangs nas/ dpyad 'jog spel mar zhag gsum du sgom mo/ de ltar byung sa dang byung mkhan med pa'i 564)dpyad pa gnad du song na/ gnas 'gag brtags mi dgos te/ dper na mo gsham gyi bu mo skye ma myong na bar du sdod pa dang*/ mthar 'chi ba btsal du med pa bzhin yin na yang*/ btsal na mi rnyed kyang da dung rnam rtog breng breng po zhig 'dug pas/ 'dir sngar med gsar du skye ba la/ dang po byung sa med kyang*/ bar du gnas pa dang*/ mthar 'gro sa zhig yod dam snyam pa'i rtog pa de zhig pa'i phyir bar du gnas pa brtag pa la/ dang po phyi snod 'jig rten la brtag na/ 'di dag gi rgyu ni 'byung ba bzhi yin la/ 'og bzhi nam mkha' yang sngags kyi lugs la zor rtse thur du bstan pa lta bu zhig bsgom kyang*/ don du sems kyi rlom pa tsam las nam mkha' zhes bya ba ci yang med la/ da lta'i snang ba skya tha le ba ni bar snang dang*/ nag bun ne ba ni mun pa las/ nam mkha' zhes blos 565)brtags pa las med pas sems gnas pa med/ de'i steng du rlung dkyil dang*/ chu dkyil/ sa yi dkyil 'khor rnams kyang rdul gyi tshogs pa yin/ dpyad na ma grub/ de steng ri rgyal yang dbyibs gru bzhi yin pas/ de ri rgyal yin na gru bzhi yin no cog de yin dgos kyang min/ kha dog dkar ser sogs su yod kyang de yin tshad ri rgyal min/ rdul phran re re nas bsal kyang ri rgyal ma grub/ de steng rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang sogs kyang dpyad na ma grub pas/ sems gnas pa'i yul 'dug pa'i gzhi/ brtan pa'i rgyu gang yang ma grub/ gser ri rol mtsho/ gling dang gling phran 'khor yug rnams cha phye bas ma grub/ nang bcud sems can la brtags na/ 'gro drug gi sgo gsum la gnas sam snyam na/

lus rdul phran/ ngag gi 566)rgyun dus gsum/ sems skad cig ma'i chas phye bas ma grub/ bsam gtan bzhi 'od lus/ gzugs med bzhi na lus dang sems kyi rgyun de yang skad cig skad cig gi rigs 'dra phyi ma 'byung ba la brtags kyang ma grub/ bye brag tu phyi yul drug nang dbang po drug bar snang mun gyi rdul bcas dpyad pas ma grub pa stong nyid bzhi sbyor gyis nges shes drangs nas dpyad 'jog spel mar zhag gsum sgom mo/ gnas mkhan gyi blo la brtags pa ni/ sems ni pho mo ma ning sogs gsungs pa ltar/ pho mo ma ning sogs 'gro ba rigs drug gi gzugs dang*/ dbyibs kha dog sogs kyi gzugs snang du rung ba dang*/ snyan mi snyan sogs kyi thos su rung ba'i sgra dang zhim mi zhim sogs snom du rung ba'i dri dang*/ kha mngar sogs myong du rung ba'i ro dang*/ 'jam rtsub sogs reg tu rung ba'i reg byar 567) ma grub pas/ dpyad na rang bzhin grub pa gang yang med pa'i stong nyid bzhi sbyor gyi nges shes drangs ba la zhag gsum sgom/ dang po skye ba dang bar du gnas pa med na/ mo gsham gyi bu mo dang po skye ba dang*/ bar du gnas pa yod ma myong na/ mthar 'chi ba gang yin dpyad mi dgos pa dang 'dra yang thog med kyi bag chags gzhig phyir mthar 'gro sa/ yal sa 'gags sa btsal na phyi yul drug nang dbang po drug bar snang mun rdul bcas gzhigs pa'i rdul phran dang*/ gzhal ba'i rdul phran gyis sngar ltar rang bzhin ma grub par dpyad pas blos stong nyid gtan la 'bebs pa de rnam grangs pa'i don dam/ yul gdod nas skye ma myong ba'i stong nyid kyi rang ldog gnas pa de rnam grangs min pa'i don dam/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba yang 568)'di dang 'dra ba yin pas/ de la dpyad 'jog spel mas zhag gsum bar du bsgom mo/ gnyis pa 'gro mkhan/ yal mkhan 'gags mkhan rnams don gcig pa/ de'i blo brtag pa ni/ pho mo ma ning sogs/

dbyibs kha dog gi gzugs sogs dang*/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi gzugs sogs/ mig gis mthong bya'i gzugs/ rna bas thos pa'i sgra/ snas tshor ba'i dri/ lces myong ba'i ro/ lus kyis reg pa'i reg bya/ thams cad med pas stong nyid du gtan la dbab/ de dag gis mdo sngags thun mong ba 'byung gnas 'gro gsum brtag pas stong nyid spros pa thams cad dang bral ba phung po rnam dpyad kyi stong nyid/ yul la shes pas dpyad pas shes pa'ang yin la/ yul gyi gnas lugs la dpyod pas shes pa'i nang nas rab dang phul du byung ba'ang yin pas blos byas kyi lta ba zhes bya zhing*/ rdzogs pa 569)chen po'i lta ba la/ ngo bo shes pa'i shes pa dang*/ rang bzhin shes pa'i shes pa gnyis su yod pa'i nang nas/ ngo bo shes pa'i shes pa zhes thog med kyi bden 'dzin gyi 'khrul snang bshig pa la/ 'di las lhag pa'i gdams ngag med pas dpyad 'jog spel ma'i sgo nas yang nas yang du bsgom pas sems btang 'gro bzhag bsdod la rang dbang thob pa'i zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa'ang 'di dag gi shugs la grub dgos pa yin no/ zhag gsum bya/ da ni rdzogs chen kho na'i rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa yul can sems kyi gshis lugs la brtags nas gnas lugs 'od gsal chen por gtan la dbab pa dang*/ de ltar gtan la dbab pa'i ye shes ngo sprod pa dang gnyis las dang po la'ang rdzogs pa chen po'i bzhag thabs 570)zhes bya ba/ lus rnam snang chos bdun lhod chags pas/ sog phon thag pa chad pa lta bu/ dbang po sgo lnga yul la mi g.yeng*/ g.yeng mi nyan bsam pa'ang med/ mig gis (ltag 'bam ?) ltag 'bol la gtad pa lta bu/ gang yang mi sems/ sems mi nyan/ mi bsam rang babs su glod/ mi dpyad/ mi smon/ mi bsam/ mi dran/ mi bcos/ mi bsgyur/ dpyad pas mi rnyed/ btsal bas mi lon/ sgrub pas mi 'grub/ ngang la bzhag rang babs su btang*/ lhod kyi glod pas/ sems kyi rnyog ma thams cad dwangs nas/

gsal seng nge*/ dwangs ye re/ phyi tshogs drug gi snang ba thams cad ma 'gags/ der 'dzin gyi dpyad pa'i spu ris ma shor/ kha ru smra rgyu med kyang*/ nyams su myong rgyu yod pa/ go mkhan tshor mkhan yin pa/ yul med kyi shes pa sbi li ma/ 571)ye shes yin yang shes pa yin dgos/ dper na rta sga med pa'i sbi li ma lta bu/ yul med kyi shes pa kha ru smra rgyu med pa/ rtog dpyod kyis bsam du med pa/ ngag gis brjod du med pa/ so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul rang myong*/ 'gags pa med pa lta bu zhig i 'dug tshol dgos/ zhag grangs bskyar/ de yod na dus gsum kyi rtog pa red dam dpyad dgos/ 'das pa'i rtog pa 'gags zin pas da lta med/ ma 'ongs pa'i rtog pa ma skyes pas da lta med/ da lta'i rtog pa yin na/ mi dge ba'i rtog pa 'dod chags/ zhe sdang*/ gti mug gi rtog pa gsum i red/ dge ba'i rtog pa dkon mchog la yid ches pa/ bden pa la yid ches pa/ las 'bras la yid ches pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba'am/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la skyo nas de las thar 'dod 572)kyi nges 'byung gi bsam pa'am/ zur gnyis sam don gnyis dang ldan pa'i byang chub kyi sems rnams red dam/ lung ma bstan gyi rtog pa za bsam 'gro bsam 'dug bsam gyi rtog pa de 'dra red dam/ yang na rtog med/ brgyal ba/ kha hon pa/ ra ro ba/ gnyid 'thug pa'i gnas skabs lta bu/ de rnams min pa zhig i 'dug blta dgos/ 'di rigs zla ba re tsam la brtag bcol nas sems thag chod nges ma red phyin rang bzhin go lo thos lo tsam gyis mi 'ong bas bla mar mos gus drag po rgyud byin gyis rlob nges pa zhig byung dus go brda' rim gyis 'phrod 'ong bas bla ma'i rnal 'byor la gnad du bsnun pa gal che ma gtogs deng sang gi khrid phal che bas rdzogs pa chen po'i ngo bo lta zhog grangs can pa'i bdag shes rig gi skyes bu yan ma song ba 'ong nyan che bas ci nas sbom yugs su ma

573)song ba zhig gal che'o/ yul dang 'dres sa de sems rnam rtog yin pas/ yul med kyi shes pa zhig nges par rnyed 'ong tshe/ de sems rig shan 'byed phyogs mthun yin zhing gong ltar dpyad tshe sgo lnga'i snang ba thams cad ni ma 'gags/ cir yang ma yin pa'i had de/ gsal le/ wal le ba/ dwangs seng nge ma song bar/ 'thibs pa'i cha'am rmugs pa'i cha zhig la ha phyam me lus na/ de kun gzhi yin/ de dang shan dbye bar zhag gcig gsal seng nge*/ dwangs ye re/ ha phyad de 'jog na 'jog bde bas/ yun ring por gnas cha de bskyangs na bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams sogs 'og 'gyu'i rtog pa phra ba long long du g.yo ba de kun gzhi'i rnam shes yin/ de dang shan phye ba la ltos shog ces zhag gcig de ma yin pa'i nyi ma 574)sprin dang bral ba lta bu/ rgya mtsho rdul dang bral ba lta bu/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa lta bu/ rig pa'i dwangs cha ma 'gags pa/ 'gro 'dug spyod lam kun tu bor mi shes pa/ gnyug ma'i shes pa phra ba/ gtad so med pa/ 'dzin pas ma gos pa/ ma sgom kyang dwangs gsal le/ sgom pas gom du med pa/ blos dpyad du med pa/ smrar med nyams su myong ba/ 'di yin gyi gtad so med pa/ 'di min gyi sgrog las grol ba/ kho thag nang nas chod pa/ zang ma thal byung gi rig pa/ dngul chu sa la lhung ba lta bu yul rkyen gang dang ma 'dres pa/ bzang zhan gyi 'pho 'gyur med pa/ bskyur yang gzhag rgyu med pa/ ma bskyur yang 'di sgom med pa/ de 'dra ba zhig kho thag chod nges par byung tshe de la chos sku bya ba yin pas/ de dag theg mchog 575)mdzod dang yon tan mdzod sogs kyi shan 'byed bcu gnyis sogs su gsungs pa'i rtsa ba lta bu yin pas gal chung dang sbom yol du ma song ba gal chen bzhag gcig de 'dra ba'i go mkhan tshor mkhan gyi shes pa sbi li ma de rig mkhan su yin/ rnam rtog gzhan gyis rig gam snyam na 'das pa'i rtog pa 'gags zin pas ma rig

ma 'ongs pa'i rtog pa ma skyes pas mi rig da lta'i rtog pa skad cig dang po skyes/ de ma 'gags/ skad cig gnyis pas rig gam snyam na/ de ltar na rnam rtog thams cad 'gags rgyu med par 'gyur dgos pas/ de mi srid/ rang gi rang rig gam snyam na rig bya rig byed gnyis yod med dpyad dgos zhag gcig gnyis yod na dpyad pa sngar dang mtshungs/ med na rang rig na/ ral gris rtses rang gi rang gcod pa dang*/ mdzub 576)mo'i rtse rang gis rang la reg pa dang*/ yang rtsal can rang gi phrag thog rang bzhon mi lo ba bzhin/ 'dir don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs ngo na khas blang ba shin tu 'gal bas ji ltar yin yang dpyad dgos zhag gcig bsgom/ 'on kyang rnam rtog gis yul la dpyod pa zhig yin nas bzung*/ blta bya yul dang*/ lta byed sems bcas yod dgos/ go mkhan tshor mkhan gyi shes pa sbi li ma gzhan gyis mi rig rang gis rang rig na rig bya rig byed gnyis yod pa'i skyon bab kyang de med la 'di rig rgyu yod la rig bya rig byed gnyis med pas mthong lo ba 'di gzhung rnams las/ ma mthong ba'i mthong ba chen po/ ma gzigs pa'i gzigs pa chen po/ yul stong nyid la blo stong nyid du shar ba/ yul spros bral la blo spros bral du shar ba 577)zhes bya ba rnams dang tshul mtshungs pas chos nyid mthong ba'i tshul ni de lta bu yin/ des shes rab dang*/ ye shes shan 'byed pa yin/ da ni rnam rtog dang ngo bo gnyis 'dra min brtag dgos pas/ rnam rtog med pa gsar du skye rgyu yod/ so sor tha dad 'dzin rgyu yod pas/ ngo bo 'di med pa gsar du skye i lo so so tha dad 'dzin i lo ltos shog ces zhag ngo bo de mi lo bas/ don dam bden pa'i ngo bo rtag pa/ 'gyur ba med pa 'dus ma byas yin/ rnam rtog kun rdzob bden pa'i ngo bo mi rtag pa/ 'gyur ba dang bcas pa 'dus byas yin/ des rdzogs pa chen po rang lugs kyi bden gnyis kyi mtshan gzhi gtan la dbab pa yin/

da ni ngo bo 'di med na rnam rtog 'di skye i lo/ rnam rtog 'di med na ngo bo yod i lo ltos 578)zhag gcig ngo bo med na rnam rtog skye mi lo ba nam mkha' med na snod bcud kyi go skabs mi 'byed pa bzhin dang*/ rnam rtog med na ngo bo yod lo ste sprin med kyang nam mkha' dang nyi ma snang lo ba bzhin/ ngo bo ni myang 'das kyi mtshan gzhi/ rnam rtog ni 'khor ba'i mtshan gzhi/ myang 'das med na 'khor ba 'byung mi shes pa med na mi 'byung gi rgyu 'bras tsam las bskyed bya skyed byed kyi rgyu 'bras min/ des 'khor 'das kyi mtshan gzhi gtan la dbab pa yin/ da rnam rtog zhig bsgom na/ yul la dmigs pa'i rnam rtog snga ma de gzung na/ de'i phyi ma skye bzhin rnam pa 'dra bar gyur pa la 'gyu bas rim gyis sgom dgos pas rnam rtog sgom na gzung dran dang*/ 'gyu dran med na mi lo/ ngo bo sgom dus gzung dran 'gyu dran i dgos dpyod ces zhag gcig 579)ngo bo la mi dgos pa de ni/ rang bzhin babs kyis bsam gtan/ gnyug ma'i dran pa/ dran mchog rgyal po/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs pa zhes bya ba yin/ rnam rtog gi dran pa ni yul la dmigs pa mi brjed pa yin/ de dag gi rdzogs pa chen po la shan 'byed/ la bzla rang grol mngon sum du ston pa gsum las/ kun gzhi dang chos sku shan 'byed/ sems dang rig pa shan 'byed/ shes rab dang ye shes shan 'byed/ kun rdzob dang don dam shan 'byed/ blo 'das kyi dran pa dang*/ yid dpyod kyi dran pa rnams shan 'byed pa yin/ la bzla ba ni thag chod ming*/ zhes pas/ da ngo bo'i steng na 'dug na dga'/ rnam rtog dge ba skyes na dga'/ rnam rtog mi dge ba skyes na mi dga' ba'i dran pa/ gsum i 'dug blta ba zhag gcig de dag ni mi nag 580)mgo gsum ba la/ dbus glang mgo g.yas stag mgo g.yon phag mgo dang 'dra bas/ bzang ngan rnam rtog thams cad ro mnyam dgos pas/

ngo bo'i steng na yod dus dge ba dang mi dge ba ci dran kyang*/ rtsal rol pa 'char tshul/ che ba'i rgyan yin pas thams cad mnyam par thag bcad dgos/ rtsal ni dwangs cha/ rol pa ni sems byung*/ 'char tshul/ che ba'i rgyan yin pas thams cad mnyam par thag bcad dgos/ rtsal ni dwangs cha/ rol pa ni sems byung*/ 'char tshul lam che ba'i rgyan ni/ dge mi dge'i rtog pa lta bu je rags la btags pa yin/ dper na/ shel gyi dwangs cha/ dkar ba'i cha 'ja' 'od bzhin no/ de la zhag gcig ngo bo'i steng na yod nas rtog pa ci skyes kyang rang shar rang grol du 'gro ba las/ rtog pa des las mi bsag pas/ dge ba med/ sdig pa med/ 'khor ba med/ myang 'das med/ sangs rgyas med/ sems can med/ yin pa 581)med/ min pa med/ sa med/ lam med/ rgyu med/ 'bras bu med sogs gsungs pa de yin pas/ dge bas phan mi btags/ sdig pas gnod mi skyel/ thams cad ro mnyam par thag chod dgos/ rtsal rnam rtog gi steng na yod dus/ dge ba yod/ sdig pa yod/ 'khor ba yod/ myang 'das yod/ sangs rgyas yod/ sems can yod/ sa yod/ lam yod/ rgyu yod/ 'bras bu yod pas/ las rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa la yid ches pas lta dpyod dpa' ( bsdar ?) ngar 'dzom pa dgos pas thabs kyis spyod pa dag shes rab kyis lta ba dag pa dgos pas theg mchog mdzod kyi shan 'byed bcu gnyis pa rgyu 'bras shan 'byed gsungs pa 'di'i steng na yin pas thag chod dgos gsungs/ da dung rig pa'i ngo bo'i lta sgom spyod gsum la dga'/ blos byas 582)kyi lta sgom spyod gsum la mi dga' ba'i 'dzin stong 'dug gam dpyod ces zhag gcig de 'ang rig pa'i ngo bo mnyam dgos pas 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid du gtan la dbab ste/ rig pa'i ngos nas thams cad rtsal rol pa sogs yin par thag chod pa ni la bzla ba ste/ de dag gi lta ba gtan la dbab pa song*/ sgom pa 'di'i bar yang res 'ga' gsungs/ spyod pa la/

thabs lam btul zhugs kyi spyod pa dang*/ grol lam bag yod kyi spyod pa gnyis/ thabs lam btul zhugs kyi spyod pa spros bcas kyi spyod pa tshom bu tshogs kyi sgrub pa dang*/ spros med kyi spyod pa dben par gzhan lus pho nya'i lam rnams ni ma hā dang a nu gnyis ka'i spyod pa yin la/ 'dir rdzogs pa chen po la grol lam bag yod kyi spyod pa nyer gcig tsam yod pa'i nang nas las dang po pas thun 583)'jug thabs kyi spyod pa zhes/ rgyu mtshan nyid theg pa dang mthun par 'jug pas de skad ces bya la/ de ni rang gi gang khas blangs ba'i sdom pa dang dam tshig rnam par dag pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos mthong mos gus sogs/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs sgo du ma nas gsog pa sogs la brten dgos te/ rang re'i sgom 'di sha ngan zhig dang 'dra/ sbrel dpyad yod na za go chod/ med na mi chod pa dang 'dra bas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags kyi brgyan na 'di phyi bar do la grol nus/ de med na kha gdangs bltas 'dug pas las dang po'i tshe sgom go mi chod/ 'chi kha bar do sogs la spyod pa 'chal ba'i grib kyis gos te grol mi nus pas/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs la brten pa gal che zhag gcig des spyod pa'i sa khongs tsam song nas/ 'bras bu bshad pa la/ gnas 584)skabs lam gyi 'bras bu dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu gnyis las/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni/ lta ba ma nor ba rtogs/ sgom pas nyams su blangs/ spyod pas la dor nas/ rig pa'i ye shes rang la ye nas rang rgyud la yod pa de sngon ngo ma shes/ da res ngo 'phrod nas de je gom la song nas/ de'i rtsal ye shes yon tan thams cad rgyas nas byang chub phyogs kyi chos so bdun po rim pa bzhin du rdzogs nas lam lnga bsgrod pa yin pas/ byang phyogs yon tan rnams mdor bsdu na/ shes rab dang*/ snying rje gnyis la 'du/ rig pa rang ngo shes pas de'i rtsal chos rab rnam 'byed kyi shes rab rgyas/

de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la/ dmigs med kyi snying rje chen po 'byung la/ de'i tshe rtags sgo gsum la 'char ba dang*/ tshad rmi lam gyis bzung ba yin/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu/ rig pa'i rang 585)ngo shes pas/ rang ngo ma shes pa'i ma rig pa de dag nas/ chags sdang rmongs gsum po je zad la 'gro/ kun slong de med pas mi dge ba'i las mi bsag par/ sems kyang gri zad bsdar zad kyis rig pa tshad phebs bar du mi ldog phra ba chos zad mthar thug bar mi ldog de ltar sgom bsgom pas rab lo gsum/ 'bring lo drug tha ma lo bdun du gom pas nyin snang mtshan snang 'khor yug tu song na/ rab tshe 'dir lus rdul phran du dengs/ sems chos nyid du dengs te/ tshes bco lnga'i nyi zla'i 'char nub lta bur grol bar 'gyur la/ 'bring nyin snang chod/ mtshan snang res 'ga' chod/ res 'ga' ma chod pa rnams chos nyid bar dor grol/ tha ma nyin snang chod/ mtshan snang ma chod pa rnams bar do gnyis par ma grol ba rnams/ rnam 586)grol dbugs chen 'byin pa'i zhing khams lngar bsgrod pa'am/ srid pa bar dor skye ba sprul pa'i sku pha ma chos ldan gyi rigs su skyes nas/ lo bco lnga'am/ nyi shu'am/ sum cu tshun la rdzogs pa chen po ston pa'i bla ma dang 'phrad nas brtse gcig nyams su blang pas tshe der ram bar dor grol bar 'gyur ro/ khregs chod gcig pu'i sangs rgyas 'grub bam snyam na 'grub te/ ngo bo stong pas ye shes kyi tshogs/ go mkhan tshor mkhan gyi shes pa sbi li ma ye shes kyi gdangs kyis bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pas zung 'jug thugs rje'i tshogs rdzogs te/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'grub pa'i rgyu tshogs yang dag par tshang ba yin no gsungs/ de la zhag gcig bya'o/ de nas slob ma la mnyam bzhag legs par bskyang bcol/ gsol 'debs lhan gcig tu/ hūm̐:bzhengs shig padma= spros 587)bral chos kyi=

chos sku kun tu bzang po'i/ 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i= 'di ltar mig gi= sogs nas/ byin gyis rlobs bar mdzod/ bzhi pa yul can sems kyi gshis lugs la dpyad de/ gnas lugs 'od gsal chen po gtan la dbab pa dang*/ de ltar gtan la dbab pa'i ye shes ngo sprod pa gnyis kyi phyi ma rig pa ngo sprod pa la/ ngo sprod bya ngos bzung ba dang*/ sprod tshul shan 'byed pa dang*/ rig pa chos skur ngo sprod pa dang gsum las dang po ni/ de ltar dpyad pa'i go mkhan tshor mkhan gyi shes pa sbi li ma de'i kho rang gi ngo bo ngos gzung*/ dbyibs kha dog gzugs sogs yod med dpyad pas gang yang ma grub pas ngo bo stong pa chos sku/ shes pa go mkhan tshor mkhan ye shes chen po'i rang bzhin sbi li ma de/ rang bzhin gsal ba longs sku/ zung 'jug thugs rje la nang 588)gsal ltar na/ ngo bo stong pa dang*/ rang bzhin gsal ba/ de gnyis stong bzhin du gsal/ gsal bzhin du stong*/ stong gsal zung 'jug de yin/ phyi gsal ltar na/ rtogs pa'i rtsal ji snyed 'char tshad thams cad rtsal/ rol pa/ 'char tshul/ che ba'i rgyan yin pas phyi gsal gyi thugs rje zung 'jug yin pas/ ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum gyi bdag nyid ngo sprad bya ngos bzung ba yin/ sprad tshul shan 'byed pa ni/ yul dang 'dres pa sems/ yul med kyi shes pa rig pa/ rmugs cha dang gnas cha kun gzhi dang*/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa/ dwangs ni chos sku/ gnyug ma'i dran pa dang*/ blos brtags kyi dran pa sogs sngar shan 'byed tshar bas/ de ring btags pa tsam las gzhan med pas/ chos skur ngo sprod pa la/ rig pa chos skur ngo sprod pa dang*/ rig rtsal 589)gang shar thams cad chos sku'i rol par ngo sprod pa dang gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rig pa'i dwangs cha de lam gyi chos skur ngo sprod pa yin/ gnyis pa ni rdzogs pa chen po'i lugs la snang srid dag pa rab 'byams 'di kho nas 'ong dgos pa yin pas/

da lta'i snang ba thams cad snang dus nyid nas mdog ma 'gyur spu ma brjes pa 'di dag gzhi snang lhun grub chen po mig gi 'char sgo'i ngang du yod pas rig pa'i rtsal du snang ba yin pas sku dang ye shes su rang chas su bzhugs pa yin/ rdzogs chen 'di la rgyu 'bras log par 'gog pa zhes bya ste/ sdug bden te/ 'gog bden du rgyu log pa'am phyogs log par ngo sprad/ kun 'byung log par 'gog pa zhes bya ste/ sdug bden de/ 'gog bden du rgyu log pa'am phyogs log par ngo sprad/ kun 'byung bden pa lam bden du rgyu log pa sogs so/ rang gzhan gyi sgo gsum sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum du snang ba la 'dzin pa zhugs pas lus ngag yid 590)gsum gyi smin po byung ba yin pas snang dus nyid nas sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum du rang chas su yod pa yin/ de la rig 'dzin chen po dga' rab rdo rjes tshig gsum gnad brdeg gi ngo rang thog tu sprad pa ni lta ba blo 'das chen po de yin/ thag gcig thog du bcad pa ni/ skyabs 'gro'i yul/ ngo bo stong pa sangs rgyas/ rang bzhin gsal ba chos/ thugs rje zung 'jug ( kun khyab min nam snyam/ ) dge 'dun/ de gsum dbyer med pa don dam pa'i skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed kyi don dam pa'i sems bskyed/ gdul bya rtags kyi bla ma da lta'i rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin yang*/ rag rig don gyi bla ma thugs ye shes chen po 'di nyid yin la/ chos can rtags kyi lha yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyang*/ chos nyid don gyi lha yang 'di nyid yin/ chos nyid kyi mkha' la thugs rje'i rtsal shar grol 'gag med du 'gro ba'i mkha' 'gro yang rtsal sna tshogs su 591)'gro ba 'di yin/ dbang thams cad kyi rtsa ba tshig dbang rin po che'i dbang don ngo sprod pa chos dbang sems la bskur ces pa yang 'di yin/ dam tshig thams cad kyang 'dir 'dus te/ rig pa'i ngo bo gcig pu skyong ba der 'das nyams kyi mkhan po med pas med pa/

rig pa gcig pu thig le nyag gcig 'di kho na bskyong chog pas gcig pu/ 'di gnyis ka dag gi dam tshig yin/ rig pa'i rang ngo rkyang pas thams cad la phyal ba ste/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi chos nyid la khyab par brdal bas phyal ba/ rig pa'i ngo bo gcig pu skyong ba la rnam rtog gi phan gnod bral bas gzhan gnod gzhir bcas spong ba so thar gyi sdom pa lhun gyis grub/ gzhan phan gzhir bcas rang shugs kyi 'grub pas byang sems kyi bslab pa lhun gyis grub/ snang srid dag pa rab 592)'byams su shar bas gsang sngags phyi nang gi dam tshig thams cad ye bsrung chen por lhun gyis grub pa yin/ 'di gnyis lhun grub kyi dam tshig yin/ mdor na dkar po dge ba'i las thams cad ngo bo 'dir ma 'dus pa med par thag chod pa ni thag gcig thog tu bcad pa yin/ de la zhag gcig bya/ des lta ba ngo sprod pa song*/ da ni sgom pas ngang skyong ba ni/ lus mi g.yo ba rnam snang chos bdun ri rgyal lta bu grol lam chos bdun lhod cha chags pa gnad yin/ dbang po mi g.yo ba rgya mtsho la gza' skar bkra ba lta bu/ rnam rtog mi dgag rjes su mi 'brang*/ snang la der 'dzin med par 'jog pa gnad/ rig pa mi g.yo ba sprin bral gyi nam mkha' lta bu gnas cha la mi bzhag dwangs cha gtso bor 'don dgos/ de'i thabs lus 'dug tshugs bca'/ mig gis nam mkha' la gtad 593)med du blta ba gnad yin/ de sgom pa mi g.yo sum ldan yin/ de la zhag gcig bya/ da ni rdzogs pa chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i spyod pa gdeng grol thog tu bca' ba la/ grol gzhi ngos bzung ba/ grol 'khrul shan 'byed pa/ rang grol mngon sum du btang ba gsum las/ grol gzhi ni/ rig pa rjen la bud pa 'di yin/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam rtog shar tshad thams cad rang grol du song na grol/ gcig rjes gnyis mthud du byung na 'khrul pa'o/ gsum pa la gzhi nor bu 'dam gyis ma gos pa bzhin du rig pa ye nas bcing grol las 'das pas ye grol lam yang grol/

rtsal rnam par rtog pa ji snyed pa rta rnga'i mdud pa rang zhig pa dang*/ sbrul mdud nam mkha' la rang grol ba dang*/ g.yu sgong 'bar ba bzhin du shar tsam 'gyu tsam 594)las yal nas gnyan po gzhan mi dgos par rang gi rang grol ba rang grol/ gnyen po gzhan dgos na stong nyid dngos po'i 'jig rgyur thal ba'i rigs pas gnod la/ rang grol/ rang zhig rang chad/ rang dag rang 'gags/ zhes pa rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin/ rnam rtog thams cad shar ba dang grol ba dus mnyam pa/ shar tshad thams cad chu la ri mo bris pa lta bu skad cig gnyis par mi bsdod par shar grol du 'gro ba yin/ de snga grol go ma chod/ da res ngo bo ngo shes pas grol go chod pa yin/ cer grol la/ spyir grol 'khrul zhes pa ngo bo'i steng na med la/ rtsal rnam par rtog pa'i steng na yod pas/ de grol ba la/ ngo shes/ rtsal rdzogs/ rang grol mngon sum du gtan la dbab pa dang gsum yod/ dang po rnam rtog gang skyes ngo shes dgos/ 595) de ma shes na sgom chen 'og 'gyus bslu/ de nas rnam rtog skyer bcol/ las bsags ma rag pa lta bur ma gyur bar rtsal rdzogs dgos/ rtsal ma rdzogs na rkyen ngan mi thub/ tha ma rang grol btang dgos/ ma grol na tha mal ba dang khyad med pas/ de grol ba'i tshul ni/ grol pa'i chos nyid ngos bzung bas grol/ des ma grol na/ rnam rtog gi steng du chos nyid phar bzhag pa lta bu byas pas ma khyogs pa'i rnam pa lta bur grol 'gro/ yang na ye shes kyi steng tshur rnam rtog bzhag pas chu la chu bur thim pa ltar grol 'gro/ grol lugs la/ rnam rtog phan med gnod med du grol ba/ bar du ngo shes pas grol ba/ tha ma grol pa'i chos nyid ngos bzung bas grol ba/ de ltar byas pas de snga rnam rtog dbang che bas 596)ye shes zil gyis gnon kyang*/ skabs zhig na ye shes stobs che bas rnam rtog phan med gnod med du grol ba na/ mthar chos zad du rnam rtog phra rags thams cad 'gags pa yin/

'bring rnam rtog ngo shes pas grol ba rkun ma ngo shes pa lta bu yin kyang*/ de gnyis 'ong ma thub na/ rnam rtog de la gzugs dbyibs kha dog sogs dpyad pas rtog pa'am/ grol pa'i chos nyid des cer gyi bltas pas grol te/ thog babs chen po'i lta ltangs kyis// sangs rgyas sems can gnyis ka grol/ zhes dge sdig gi rtog pa thams cad grol ba yin/ mtha' thams cad las 'das pas mtha' grol dang*/ ye shes gcig pu rang grol bas gcig grol sogs drug yod kyang*/ nyams su len dus grol tshul bzhis chog la/ des na phyag chen dang rdzogs chen gnyis kyang grol tshul 597)bzhis khyad par 'phags so/ des ni gdeng grol thog tu bca' ba ste/ rdzogs pa chen po'i thun mong min pa'i sgom tshul gyi spyod pa yin no/ da ni rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa rjes nyams kyis skyong tshul bstan pa la nyams rtogs shan dbye ba/ la bzla ba/ rang grol mngon sum du gtan la dbab pa'o/ dang po ni/ gu ru rin po ches/ phyi ltar gzung pa'i sogs/ bar du 'od gsal rang ngo ma shes dpyad nyams bzang po la zhen/ ngan pa la 'dor 'dod byed pa 'dis lan pa yin pas/ rtogs pa ni rig pa tha mal shes pa rjen la bud pa 'di yin/ nyams la/ lus nyams/ ngag nyams/ sems nyams gsum yod/ sngon gyis dkar po rnam par 'phel ba'i mthu dang*/ rtsa rlung bzang po 'dus pa las nyams bzang po 598)skye/ sngon las ngan pa dang*/ rtsa rlung ngan pa 'dus pa las ngan pa 'byung la/ lus nyams bzang po/ lus bde ba/ skyid pa/ nam mkha' la 'phur nus/ sa 'og tu 'dzul nus/ ri brag la thogs med du phyin pa sogs 'byung*/ ngan nyams/ nad gdon sogs mi 'dod pa du ma 'byung*/ ngag la bzang nyams/ tshig bcad rdol ba/ ngag snyan pa sogs/ ngan nyams/ dig lkugs 'gags pa sogs/ yid la snang nyams dang*/ shes nyams gnyis yod/ snang nyams bzang ba/ lha'i zhal mjal ba/ gsung thos pa/ brda' yig sogs snang ba yin/ ngan nyams 'dre dang*/

rgyal po sogs snang ba/ shes nyams bzang ba/ bde bgasa'i nyams su lus 'o ma dron/ mo'i chu rgyun gyis bkrus pa lta bu mal nas 'gul snying mi 'dod pa lta bu/ gsal nyams lus phyi nang dang*/ sgo phyi 599)nang mi sgrib pa lta bu/ mi rtog pa'i nyams/ rnam rtog i skye bltas na mi skye ba rnams dang*/ ngan nyams chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi rtog pa sogs 'byung*/ mdor na 'khor 'das thams cad nyams yin/ 'khor ba rgyu 'bras thams cad ngan nyams/ myang 'das rgyu 'bras thams cad bzang nyams yin/ des nyams rtog shan phye ba yin/ gnyis pa la bzla ba ni/ la bzla ba ni thag chod ming*/ zhes pas/ nyams bzang ngan thams cad rtogs pa'i rtsal rol pa 'char tshul che ba'i rgyan yin par go dgos/ de go bas bzang po la blang sems dang zhen sems med/ ngan pa la 'dor sems dang*/ spang sems med par thams cad mnyam par thag bcad dgos/ nyams rtogs de gnyis phar dpyad na chu la rlabs 'byung yang*/ rlabs su snang dus nyid/ rlabs nyid chud las ma 'das pa bzhin rtsal rol par 'char 600)tshul che ba'i rgyan du thag bcad/ tshur dpyad na/ rlabs de nyid chu las byung yang*/ chu rang sa las ma g.yos pa ltar/ go mkhan tshor mkhan gyi shes pa sbi li ma tha mal gyi shes pa rjen la bud pa rang yin pas/ gnyis su snang yang gnyis su ma grub par thag bcad dgos/ gsum pa rang grol mngon sum du ston pa ni/ nyams gang skyes kyang*/ de bshig pa'i phyir/ lus kyi bca' bshig mig gis lta stangs brje/ ngag gis phaṭa sgra drag po thog lhung lta bu brjod/ sems kyi sgom blo bor/ tha mal kyi smra ba bcad de bzhag na/ nyams bzang ngan gang shar ba thams cad grol sa'i chos nyid kyi steng du rang grol du grol bas/ rnal 'byor bsgom pa bshig kyin bzang*// phu chu drag po brdab cing bzang*/ zhes pas/ sgom bsam pa brgya bas kyang*/ mi bsgom bsam pa gcig gis dga'/ lo gcig 601)bsgoms pa bas/

nyin gcig sgom blo bshig pa khag che bas/ mi bsgom bsam nas sgom blo gshig pas gnas lugs rjen pa cer la bud pa yin no/ des nyams kyi skyong tshul bstan pa dang bcas pas ka dag khregs chod kyi khrid thun mong ma yin pa gcig rgyud rnams re zhig bshad zin to/ zhes pa'ang bdag gi rnam 'dren skyabs rje rdo rje 'chang gi yang srid rin po che'i thugs dam gsal 'debs su kun mkhyen bla ma'i zhal lung gang zin rig 'dzin dpal chen 'dus pas bris pa dge legs 'phel/ khrid ma thob pa rnams la dpe 'di gsang rgya/ gu hya/ dge'o// 602)
